decision: A Remove accessibility action on a reused, re-parented chip resolves the current attachment and current delegate when it runs, honours read-only state, and leaves the visible buttons reachable.

evidence.note: Transfer of file-row-delete-action: delegate owner instead of closures, didSet rebinding instead of configure, owner reassignment instead of row reuse. Other-model evidence only.

variants.why: Rebuilds a named selector action on each change and forwards to the Remove button's own action method.
Captures the delegate and attachment when the action is built; after the chip moves windows, removal reaches the old window's controller.
DisabledShortcut mechanism: removes attachments from a read-only message through the Actions menu.
Treats the shortcut as a replacement and hides the x button from accessibility.
